stories.headline: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
stories.what_happened: Google Deepmind tests the reliability of 18 AI models with "Humanity's First Exam." Top models solve nearly every task family at least once, but even leaders like OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra stumble when asked for 16 straight correct answers. Visual perception accounts for 73 percent of errors, and more compute time doesn't fix the problem. stories.headline: In a first, ultrasound maps blood flow through an entire human kidney in 3D
stories.what_happened: For the first time, a research team at the Inserm Institute of Physics for Medicine (Inserm/ESPCI Paris-PSL/CNRS) in Paris has succeeded in visualizing the entire vascular network and blood flow in a human kidney. This breakthrough opens up promising clinical prospects: improving our understanding and diagnosis of kidney diseases linked to vascular defects. To achieve this, the researchers used a new ultrasound technique developed in their laboratory and previously tested in animals, which could eventually be extended to other organs. The results are published in The Lancet Medical Imaging & Theranostics.
